free_tier.stated: Not counted against any storage quota. GitLab docs: 'Only the project's repository and LFS are included in the storage limit. The container registry, package registry, and build artifacts are not included in the limit.' The 10 GiB Free limit therefore does not apply to OCI blobs.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no container image or layer size limit is stated on the GitLab.com limits page, whose container registry section lists the domain name, IP address, CDN domain name, CDN IP address and authorization token duration.
per_object_cap.notes: No size limit appears in the GitLab.com container registry settings table.

retention.notes: Dormant project deletion is disabled on GitLab.com. No expiry period for container images is stated on the pages read.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress charge or volume quota is stated on the pages read. Anonymous pulls: a public project whose container registry visibility is set to Everyone With Access lets anonymous users view the registry and pull images.

tooling: ORAS / docker / skopeo / crane all work against registry.gitlab.com; rclone has no OCI backend but 'oras cp' + rclone covers push/pull. Public projects allow anonymous pull tokens.
chaining: The container registry is not included in the project storage limit, which covers the project's repository and LFS (10 GiB for a Free tier namespace project). A per-layer cap of 5 GB, and the number of projects or accounts allowed: unverified, not stated on the pages read.
limits_note: Container registry storage is visible without published caps in documentation. Blob uploads use the standard Docker chunked protocol, where layer size is determined by user build configuration rather than documented file limits. Pushes require CI tokens, and public projects permit anonymous pulls.
reliability_note: Storage is reported under 'reduce container registry storage' but no hard cap or eviction is documented on Free; the risk is administrative cleanup of dormant projects rather than quota enforcement.
